conventions.note: No conventions file existed for wterm. Compiled from AGENTS.md docs rules, ci.yml, and three prior cases.

deterministic.detail: rebuild-wasm:docker added to package.json scripts while rebuild-wasm stayed documented in packages/@wterm/ghostty/README.md and apps/docs/src/app/ghostty/page.mdx
Sole non-test consumer is packages/@wterm/dom/src/renderer.ts:364-368, which reads len then cells for one offset with no state mutation between. Interface signatures unchanged.
first gate run on this branch

findings.title: u32 scrollback offset wraps to the newest row
findings.evidence: getScrollbackLineLen(0xffffffff) returned 8 on an 8-column terminal instead of 0. usize is 32-bit on wasm32, so offset + 1 wrapped. First fix attempt (@as(usize, offset)) did not work for exactly that reason and was caught by the new test.
findings.resolution: std.math.add(usize, offset, 1) catch return 0, plus a regression test

findings.title: scrollbackLimit documented as lines, is a byte budget
findings.source: gate step 3 (subsystem model), while verifying reviewer finding on page pruning
findings.evidence: ghostty src/terminal/Screen.zig:272 documents max_scrollback in bytes. Measured retained rows at the 10000 default: 40 cols 2304, 80 cols 1154, 160 cols 568. Halves as width doubles; never 10000.

findings.title: Detached DataView on the scrollback cache-hit path
findings.evidence: memory.grow(64) between getScrollbackLineLen(0) and getScrollbackCell(0,1) threw TypeError: Underlying ArrayBuffer has been detached. Regression test verified red against the unfixed source.
findings.resolution: buffer identity check covering both hit and miss paths, commit f807b22

findings.title: Reflow test did not pin reflow
findings.evidence: fill() writes rows under 8 cells, so resizing 80 to 40 wrapped nothing. Writing a genuine 103-character logical line surfaced that the built-in core does not reflow at all (returns len 80 in a 40-column terminal) while ghostty rewraps correctly.
findings.resolution: test rewritten to assert ghostty's own reflow behavior rather than cross-core parity

exemptions.claim: Wide-character scrollback cells render an extra column (reviewer finding 3)
exemptions.evidence: CellData carries no width field for any core, so getCell drops width identically in the viewport. Already tracked as open issue vercel-labs/wterm#71, which names this exact symptom.
exemptions.verdict: duplicate of a tracked pre-existing issue

exemptions.evidence: Measured viewport and scrollback on the same input: byte-identical output, both drop ZWJ and combining marks. get_viewport has the same one-u32-per-cell limit. Pre-existing.

exemptions.claim: _ensureViewport has the same early-return detached-view bug
exemptions.evidence: Reproduced against origin/main, so pre-existing and not introduced by this diff. Verified against the merge base, not an earlier commit on the branch.
exemptions.verdict: out of scope, issue candidate below

exemptions.evidence: AGENTS.md states releases are manual, single-PR, maintainer-controlled.

issue_candidates.title: Renderer corrupts scrollback when ghostty prunes a page
issue_candidates.evidence: syncScrollback treats a count delta as added or removed rows. ghostty prunes whole pages: at 80x24 with the default limit, count drops 1154 to 566 in a single write while a new newest row is added. The renderer removes 588 oldest elements and never inserts the new offset-0 row, shifting every rendered row by one from then on. The built-in core never decreases its count, so this path was only ever reachable with ghostty, and only observable once scrollback rendered at all.
issue_candidates.scope: packages/@wterm/dom, pre-existing, made visible by this PR

issue_candidates.title: Scrollback DOM rows are built once and never rebuilt
issue_candidates.evidence: syncScrollback returns early when the count is unchanged, so a content change to an existing row never reaches the DOM. Demonstrated with OSC 4: the core returns the new palette color for a scrolled-off cell while the rendered row keeps the old one. Same root cause as the prune finding.

issue_candidates.title: _ensureViewport returns a possibly detached DataView
issue_candidates.evidence: Same early-return shape as the scrollback bug fixed here. Reproduced on origin/main: getCell after memory.grow throws.

issue_candidates.title: Built-in core does not reflow scrollback on resize
issue_candidates.evidence: After resize(40,12) a scrollback row written at 80 columns still reports length 80 and keeps its original wrapping, while ghostty rewraps to 40.

issue_candidates.title: ghostty core drops grapheme continuation codepoints
issue_candidates.evidence: Built-in emits 1f468 200d 1f469 200d 1f467 and 65 301; ghostty emits 1f468 1f469 1f467 and 65. The README comparison table claims the opposite (built-in 'single codepoints', ghostty 'full grapheme clusters').
